label: PILOT/DEVELOPMENT

retrieval.question: Can VCS reliability improve NCE after protecting every U pair and fixing total U mass, relative to BCE and constant weighting?
retrieval.input: frozen N2F observed pairs and scalar VCS/BCE weight files; no noise-oracle labels, no new critic fitting
retrieval.transform: w_task=.1+.8*sigmoid(logit(clip(w,1e-6,1-1e-6))+b), b fixed by90-step bisection to mean_U=.5. Constant control w_U=.5; anchors1; full-pool normalizer.55.
retrieval.interpretation: Transformed weights are task weights, not calibrated clean posteriors. Scalar VCS/BCE have the same teacher-score ordering; compare confidence/calibration shapes.
retrieval.objective: original symmetric NCE tau.05; only positive row/column terms weighted; all negatives unchanged.
retrieval.recipe: original SGR architecture/init, all145000 observed pairs,128batch, Adam2e-4, lr*.1 epoch30, clip2, fullDEV each epoch, earliest maxrSum selection.

extension.note: Independent of original A3 gate. No duplicate A3 jobs. Report seed901 as selected pilot and new902/903 separately.

analyses: bestDEV, finalDEV and last5epoch rSum, all recalls
weight mean/min/max/ESS and numerical VCS-BCE differences
same sample order and initial model across arms
limitations: A single preset floor/targetmean is not an optimum claim.
Same monotone score ranking limits evidence for unique sample identification.
All retrieval selection remains on DEV; no independent TEST.
